powers.name: Plan Mode
powers.what: it thinks and shows a plan BEFORE touching files - Shift+Tab to cycle into it

powers.name: Think harder
powers.what: Alt+T toggles extended thinking for tough problems

powers.name: Rewind
powers.what: with an empty input, Esc twice (or /rewind) rolls the code back to before a bad attempt

powers.name: Interrupt & steer
powers.what: press Esc mid-run to stop a bad direction - don't wait for it to finish

powers.name: Fresh head
powers.what: /clear between unrelated tasks keeps the agent sharp

powers.name: Paste screenshots
powers.what: Ctrl+V pastes an image - it can SEE the layout bug you're describing

powers.name: @file mentions
powers.what: type @ and the filename to point at the exact file instead of describing it

powers.name: Permanent notes
powers.what: say 'remember: prices are in kroner' and it sticks for every future session - /memory shows what's saved

powers.name: Queued messages
powers.what: keep typing while it works - your messages line up and run in order

powers.name: Pick up where you left off
powers.what: /resume reopens an old session; contextkit's roadmap re-briefs it every time

powers.name: Run commands yourself
powers.what: start a message with ! to run a terminal command and share its output

powers.name: Permission modes
powers.what: Shift+Tab cycles ask-first / auto-accept edits / plan mode

powers.name: Connect your tools
powers.what: MCP plugs in Stripe, your database, email, the web - /connect-mcp sets it up

powers.name: Web search
powers.what: ask it to search or read a URL - it can fetch current docs and prices

powers.name: Subagents
powers.what: for big searches or audits it can send out parallel helpers - just ask

powers.name: Model switching
powers.what: /model - a heavier model for hard problems, a fast one for simple edits

powers.name: Voices
powers.what: /config -> Output style: contextkit ships a teaching voice and a buddy voice

powers.name: Automation
powers.what: claude -p runs it inside scripts - how contextkit benchmarks itself

powers.name: Hooks
powers.what: real scripts that fire on events (session start, before a tool runs, at the end) - contextkit's own greeting and ask-first lock are hooks

powers.name: Save it as a skill
powers.what: any ritual you repeat can live at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md - then /<name> runs it and Claude auto-uses it when it fits
